scope_decisions.spatial_baseline: Uniform amplitude and longitudinal current, phase gradient q; all spectral and distribution fields consistent with same current-carrying bulk branch
scope_decisions.boundary_condition: Continuation of same current-carrying equilibrium, not zero-current BCS reservoirs
scope_decisions.current_match_across_lengths: Same I_DC; phase advance q*L changes with length

inductance_partition_recommendation.physical_units: H for L_ext_ref; H/m for L_bulk_diff_per_m_ref; q in 1/m; I in A
inductance_partition_recommendation.phase_current_convention: Use a consistent positive passive-current phase convention; derivative must have stable positive inductive sign
inductance_partition_recommendation.resolved_length_includes: Entire 2D window plus any explicitly resolved 1D continuations
inductance_partition_recommendation.sheet_estimate_role: Secondary transparent comparison of scale; do not force equality with fitted microscopic material

Add I*dL/dt to a full resolved port already carrying condensate dynamics
Treat the 0.096-0.384nH initial geometric estimate as an upper bound near a normal core
inductance_partition_recommendation.alternative_if_consistent_total_availabl: Fixed L_ext=L_total_ref-L_resolved_ref evaluated once; alternative accounting, never used simultaneously with segment addition

remaining_before_photon_admission: Uniform DC reference must pass actual discrete relaxation and spatial checks; copied analytic values alone are not evidence.
Bulk boundary fields must include finite-current spectral depairing, not only imposed phase.
Future dynamic ports must follow the circuit consistently; do not freeze both phase endpoints during current redistribution.
Finite-energy nonlinear heat balance and admitted absolute material rates remain separate from a zero-power DC null test.
Photon transfer, spatial width, omitted cascade delay and measurement trigger remain under their existing scope contracts.
The fixed exterior approximation is controlled modeling, not proof of frequency-independent experimental transfer at all frequencies.
